analysis.summary: The PR introduces high-severity functional bugs in the CI/CD pipeline logic and the package export configuration that will prevent deployments and cause runtime errors for package consumers.

bugs.title: Broken Pipeline Gates via Incorrect Environment Variable Access
bugs.description: The pipeline uses 'build.env()' to check for values provided in 'block' step fields (e.g., RUN_PRE_RELEASE_DECLARATIONS, DEPLOY_FIREWALL_DEV). In Buildkite, values from block fields are stored in 'meta-data', not environment variables.
bugs.risk: All manual gates for pre-releases, firewall deployments, and release publishing will fail to trigger. Even if a user selects 'Yes' in the prompt, the dependent steps will be skipped because the environment variable check will always evaluate to null/false.
bugs.codeSnippet:
- label: 'pre-release declarations'
        depends_on: 'pre-release-declarations'
        if: build.env("RUN_PRE_RELEASE_DECLARATIONS") == "yes"
        plugins: *common_plugins

bugs.title: Runtime Crash for Package Consumers due to TS Export
bugs.description: The 'exports' configuration maps the ESM 'import' path directly to a TypeScript source file (./docs-dist/api-types.ts). Standard Node.js runtimes (like the Node 20 environment used in this repo) cannot execute .ts files directly.
bugs.risk: Any application attempting to import from '@smart/api-integration-aws' will experience a runtime crash (ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION) unless they have a specialized loader configured. Since this is an API integration package intended for distribution, this breaks standard consumption.

bugs.title: Release-it Branch Mismatch Configuration
bugs.description: The 'release-it' configuration restricts execution to specific branches ('feature/*', 'main', etc.), but the pipeline allows the 'Pre-release' group to trigger on ANY branch except 'main' (including 'develop' or 'release/*').
bugs.risk: The 'pre-release declarations' step will fail with a 'requireBranch' error when triggered from 'develop' or 'release/' branches, despite the pipeline explicitly providing a manual block for those branches.

notBugs.reason: While versions like 'zod' ^4.3.6 and 'release-it' ^19.2.4 do not exist on the public NPM registry, the project was already using ^4.0.5 for zod, suggesting a private registry or internal mirroring. This is not a new bug introduced here.
Adding 'params' to 'patchCartDoc' and 'deleteCartEntryDoc' is a correction to the OpenAPI spec to match the actual path segments (like {cartId}) defined in the routes.
